summary: Comprehensive independent scientific generalization audit and large-scale empirical evaluation of SARcasmScope across 5,712 real-world samples from 5 peer-reviewed public datasets (ACL 2020 Twitter, Misra News Headlines, IIIT Delhi MaSaC, L3Cube-MahaEmotions Marathi, IIIT Hyderabad Telugu). Analyzes dataset independence, data leakage, domain transfer failure modes, specificity vs. recall, and research paper publication guidance.
